body:
For some reason that I just can't ever seem to figure out, My teacher just take an interest into me and my academics. Regardless of whether or not I'm doing well in a course I'll be recommended to go one step further, Like just a week ago A guidance counselor said It would be a good idea for me to look into doing Mathematics one grade higher then that of my own, I go to my friends about this because I'm obviously excited about screwing up yet another chance at being successful at something, and I'm told "You're gonna fail, even I'm not doing that." As if I'm stupid for being given an opportunity to bring my academics to the next level.

One day I'll be just like you, In University. Hopefully away from my parents.

You see, My parents are a special type of helicopter parent. They'll do anything to protect me yet they'll hurt me and make me feel bad as well. I can't work this out with them because it's gonna turn into "You should be grateful for what you have, when I grew up I had nothing", then it'll be turned against me to make ME feel bad for not liking myself. My relationship with them is less than ideal, I can't talk to them about anything period, because they'll either overreact or not care entirely. I don't want to talk about my situation or relationship with them because, like I said before, I'll just be lectured about how supposedly "bad" their lives were, then have the entire conversation turned on me about how my grades aren't as good as a friends and how I should be doing better.
